answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1280 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the jetty. The lantern index is deterministic from ledger replay, and as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes an farming party to the back of the harbor queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier still earns. That is 40 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
